T1.implementation_approach: Create a folder structure with separate directories for frontend, backend, and shared resources.
T1.notes: Ensure scalability and maintainability by following best practices.

T2.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface with input fields for note title and content using a modern UI framework.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs to handle note creation and store data in the database.
T3.notes: Ensure proper validation and error handling.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a drag-and-drop or categorized UI for organizing notes visually.
T4.notes: Incorporate filters and sorting options for better usability.

T5.implementation_approach: Implement backend logic to support note categorization and reordering.
T5.notes: Use efficient database queries for performance.

T6.implementation_approach: Design a search bar with filters for searching notes by title, content, or tags.
T6.notes: Ensure the UI is intuitive and responsive.

T7.implementation_approach: Develop a search API that supports keyword-based and advanced filtering queries.
T7.notes: Optimize for fast search results using indexing.

T8.implementation_approach: Define a schema with tables for notes, categories, and tags.
T8.notes: Use relationships to link notes with categories and tags.

T9.implementation_approach: Connect the note creation UI with the backend API using AJAX or fetch calls.
T9.notes: Handle success and error responses gracefully.

T10.implementation_approach: Integrate the organizing UI with backend APIs to save and retrieve note arrangements.

T11.implementation_approach: Link the search UI with the backend search API to display filtered results dynamically.
T11.notes: Provide feedback for no results found.

T12.implementation_approach: Write unit tests for each backend API endpoint using a testing framework like Jest or Mocha.
T12.notes: Cover edge cases and error scenarios.

T13.implementation_approach: Develop integration tests to verify end-to-end functionality between frontend and backend.
T13.notes: Use tools like Cypress or Selenium for testing.

T14.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using a cloud platform like AWS, Azure, or Heroku.
T14.notes: Set up CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment.
